body.purpose: Every UI surface. Hanken Grotesk is the only active typeface; Bricolage Grotesque is self-hosted but unused.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal Blue solid button, flat at rest, color-shift on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2C6BD4; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2362CA; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2C6BD4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent background, foreground text — secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #0E2240; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #D9D4CB; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F0EBE2; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat container, one lightness step above the page background, no shadow at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #D9D4CB; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #0E2240; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-desc { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 14px; color: #5C6778; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Icon Tile
components.description: Tinted icon badge. Background and foreground must come from different token roles — pairing bg-icon with text-primary (both blue) made the glyph invisible in a real, shipped bug.
components.css: .ds-icon-tile { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; background: #EAF0FB; color: #0E2240; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

narrative.overview: WhoDB is a database management tool for people who already know what they're doing. The interface doesn't perform competence — it assumes it. Every surface exists to frame data, never to decorate it. All tokens flow from @clidey/ux's Clidey brand kit (imported directly via @import '@clidey/ux/brand.css'): Paper/Ink dual-mode, Signal Blue as the product accent, Beacon Yellow as the single sanctioned highlight, Clidey Orange reserved for company-branded moments rather than general product UI.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces by default; depth comes from a lightness step between surfaces, not shadow or blur
Dual theme: Paper (light) and Ink (dark), both first-class
Hanken Grotesk carries the UI; Bricolage Grotesque is self-hosted and available but not currently applied anywhere in the product UI
A user-facing density system (Settings) swaps font-size, radius, and spacing scales between small/medium/large and none/small/medium/large tiers respectively
Token-driven styling via CSS custom properties from @clidey/ux — extend, don't override component internals with !important

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: A single surface uses exactly one accent hue at a time. Blue leads product UI; orange leads company-branded moments. They do not mix on the same card or banner.

rules.name: The Density-Tier Rule
rules.body: Font sizes, radius, and spacing are all user-adjustable via Settings (small/medium/large tiers). Don't hardcode a pixel value where a var(--font-size-*)/var(--radius-*)/var(--spacing-*) token exists — hardcoding breaks the density switch for that element.

dos: Do use flat, token-driven backgrounds for all static surfaces.
Do use var(--font-size-*), var(--radius-*), and var(--spacing-*) tokens rather than hardcoded values, so the density-customization system keeps working.
Do respect both themes equally — verify contrast against the actual surface text sits on.
Do extend @clidey/ux via CSS custom properties, never by overriding component styles with !important.
donts: Don't mix Signal Blue and Clidey Orange on the same surface.
Don't add drop shadows to cards or containers at rest.
Don't assume Bricolage Grotesque renders anywhere — it's self-hosted but unused; Hanken Grotesk is the only active UI typeface.
Don't pair a tinted tile's background and foreground from the same color role.
Don't use hardcoded color values (bg-white, dark:bg-gray-800). Use semantic tokens.
